notes.title: Updated to version 1.2
notes.notes:
At your request, keyboard controls have been improved. Now there is no slowdown and inertia when controlling the player using the keyboard.
If anyone liked the old controls better, let me know, and I'll give you the option to choose between the old and new controls.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
EDITED: I added the ability to choose between the old control and the new one.
Now in the SETTINGS you can enable or disable "Inertia" (it is enabled by default)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A small change on the second level makes it more comfortable to pass in the area of structures that are dangerous for collision.

Some changes in the interface of the store (hangar), are aimed at understanding the gameplay.

Replaced the icon with a new one, courtesy of Bob Mandel.

notes.title: Release date revealed
notes.notes:
I am excited to reveal that Vostok 2061 now has an official release date: [b]7th of October 2022[/b]
I hope to see you all! Deep space is waiting for you!
